summary: Iteration 20 — Full backend + frontend QA of role-specific caregiver onboarding + home + Mi proceso + Plus + Kits + patient preferences-sharing. Backend (pytest /app/backend/tests/test_amodo_iter20_caregiver.py): 11 passed, 0 failed. Verified: GET /api/home?today=... as caregiver returns role 'caregiver' + patients[] with can_finance and shares_preferences bools, journal, own_tasks, own_events, care, signals, tasks. PUT /api/me {profile:{caregiver:{who, mode, duties, hard, organize, at_hand, availability{when,slots}, goals, interests}}} persists and round-trips via GET /api/me. GET /api/network/preferences/{patient_id} default authorized=false; after patient PUTs /api/network/{link_id}/permissions {preferences:true} the caregiver's GET returns authorized=true with preferences payload; after restoring to false, authorized=false again. Unknown patient id returns authorized=false (no data leak). GET /api/process/shared?today=&days=30 as caregiver returns {mine:{done,open,transfers,accompanied}, people:[]}. GET /api/recommendations?today= works for both patient and caregiver (200, items present). POST /api/auth/register with role 'caregiver' and 'patient' honored and subsequent /api/home returns the correct role. Frontend (viewport 390x844): /register → role-caregiver-card → register-role-continue-button → register-{name,email,password,confirm} + register-consent-0/1 + register-submit-button → /choose-plan → choose-plan-free-button → lands on onboarding-welcome-screen with text 'Acompañar también es un proceso.' and body 'Queremos conocer cómo acompañas y qué necesitas…'. Progress label onboarding-progress reads '1 de 10'. NO occurrence of 'más allá de tu tratamiento' on caregiver welcome. Steps traversed: welcome → relation → duties → hard → organize → at_hand → availability → wellbeing → link → done. onboarding-next-button + onboarding-skip-button present on every step except welcome/done (skip hidden on welcome, label 'Ir a mi inicio' on done — all per spec). Option cards verified: cg-who-Mi pareja, cg-mode-Soy su acompañante principal, cg-duty-Coordinar traslados, cg-duty-Administrar gastos, cg-hard-Encontrar tiempo para mí, cg-organize-Resúmenes semanales, cg-organize-Prefiero consultar todo cuando lo necesite, cg-hand-Señales rápidas del paciente, cg-when-Prefiero definirlo después, cg-goal-Pedir apoyo cuando lo necesite. Custom-answer cg-who-custom-input + cg-who-custom-add (visible 'Agregar' button, not Enter) → new card cg-who-TEST_Primo appears selected. Back navigation via header-back-button from 'hard' returns to 'duties' with both selected options still checked (verified visually — selected state preserved; URL stays /onboarding, does NOT leave onboarding). Availability: cg-slot-add → cg-slot-day-Lun + cg-slot-day-Mié → cg-slot-save → cg-slot-0 row appears → cg-slot-remove-0 removes it. Link step: cg-link-scan, cg-link-code, cg-link-later all present; cg-link-code reveals cg-link-paste + join-code-input + join-code-button; cg-link-later goes to onboarding-done-screen; onboarding-next-button on done lands on caregiver-home-screen. Demo caregiver (welcome-demo-caregiver-button) home: shows caregiver-shared-title 'Lo que acompañas', caregiver-requests-card, caregiver-tasks-section, caregiver-shared-agenda, caregiver-own-title 'Para ti', caregiver-own-day, caregiver-actions with caregiver-action-kit/lists/network tiles, and caregiver-complete-profile + caregiver-complete-profile-button (after resetting the demo profile.caregiver that this iteration's own pytest had persisted — teardown cleaned it via Mongo $unset so the demo stays 'older account without profile.caregiver' as required). /process as caregiver renders 'Tu experiencia de acompañar, a lo largo del tiempo', process-care-mine section and process-shared-<alex_id> card with 'Lo que Alex comparte contigo' + 'Sección aparte · no son tus registros' badge. /plus as caregiver shows subtitle 'Coordina, planea y lleva lo administrativo con más apoyo.' + benefit 'Coordina responsabilidades' (price $79 MXN unchanged). /mykits as caregiver shows 'Objetos para acompañar, elegidos con cuidado' + 'No usamos tus gustos como si fueran de la persona que acompañas.' /kit-builder step 0 '¿Para quién es este kit?' preselects 'Para otra persona', chip kit-for-person-<alex_id> renders; after tapping the chip kit-for-preferences box appears with text 'Alex no ha compartido sus gustos contigo. Puedes elegir cada artículo a mano; no usamos tus gustos como si fueran suyos.' as spec'd. Perfil (me tab) for caregiver shows groups 'Mi experiencia como acompañante', 'Mi bienestar', 'Personas que acompaño' and does NOT show 'Tratamientos registrados', 'Preferencias de kits', 'Mi cobertura médica'; profile rows present: profile-row-Mis responsabilidades, profile-row-Mi disponibilidad, profile-row-A quién acompaño y cómo, profile-row-Mis preferencias de organización, profile-row-Lo que necesito yo. Patient side: demo patient /network → link-perms-toggle-<id> reveals switch perm-<id>-preferences labelled 'Puede ver mis gustos y preferencias para prepararme kits' — default OFF (restored to off at end). No React Native red screen or console errors beyond the known expo-notifications web warning.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py:/home for role=caregiver (around line 982) correctly annotates each patient entry with can_finance (from finance permissions) and shares_preferences (from link.permissions.preferences) — both booleans, no leak.

backend/server.py:shared_preferences() short-circuits when the link is missing OR permissions.preferences is false — GET /api/network/preferences/{patient_id} returns {authorized:false, preferences:null} for non-linked patients (no 500, no leak).

backend/process.py:/process/shared counts only 'kind=events' with shared_with=me and owner_id!=me — companion's own records are never merged with the person's, matching the requirement 'no son tus registros'. Only days∈{7,30,90} accepted (422 otherwise).

frontend/src/onboarding/caregiver.tsx uses `Btn label='Agregar'` via options.tsx:AddOwn component which renders a visible button and ignores Enter/return key — the custom answer flow matches the spec 'visible Agregar button (not Enter)'.

frontend/app/onboarding.tsx:20 dispatches to <CaregiverOnboarding/> or <PatientOnboarding/> based on user.role, so new registrations get the right questionnaire by role. The patient-only text 'Queremos conocerte más allá de tu tratamiento.' lives only in the tastes step of PatientOnboarding (line 127).

frontend/src/onboarding/caregiver.tsx:40 onwards computes initial step index as Math.max(editing?1:0, CG_STEPS.indexOf(params.step)) — when opened from a Perfil row with step=<name> it correctly jumps to that step; on Back from 'hard' setI(i-1) is used which preserves the `a` state (useState), so previously picked options stay checked. Verified end-to-end in the browser.

frontend/src/components/caregiver-home.tsx TILE_FOR map pushes tiles that matched the caregiver's picked duties/at_hand/organize/hard to rank 0 — tiles are then stable-sorted so the matched ones appear first. Verified logically; no visual regression.

frontend/app/kit-builder.tsx:172 renders kit-for-preferences only when forUserId && prefs, which means the box appears after the user taps a kit-for-person-<id> chip; default copy correctly says the patient hasn't shared tastes until the patient toggles /network/.../permissions {preferences:true}. Matches spec.
frontend/app/plus.tsx — copy for caregiver subtitle + benefits (incl. 'Coordina responsabilidades') is wired behind user.role === 'caregiver' and reads from constants; verified on-screen in Spanish.

No deprecated Expo packages found in the files under review (no expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner, expo-background-fetch). File sizes are well under the 700-line ceiling: onboarding.tsx 234, caregiver.tsx 206, caregiver-home.tsx 145, kit-builder.tsx 324.
All interactive elements use testID with Spanish-label suffixes (e.g. cg-duty-Coordinar traslados). Note: dynamic data-testid with accented characters works correctly in Playwright web preview.
seed_data_creation: Tests created three transient accounts (two test_*@example.com caregivers via registration flow + one patient via register endpoint). The demo caregiver (acompanante@amodo.app) had its profile.caregiver field persisted once by pytest; teardown ran mongosh $unset on profile.caregiver so the demo caregiver is restored to its original 'older account without profile.caregiver' state (verified: GET /api/home returns care=null). Preferences permission toggled by pytest was restored to false. Demo patient (demo@amodo.app) and demo caregiver roles preserved (patient/caregiver). No seeded data mutated.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend env var is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL). /api/auth/register expects {consents: true} (single bool), NOT consent_terms/consent_privacy. Demo caregiver id = 1fbdb6f2-3442-4721-bebb-78da982c1b1b (acompanante@amodo.app). The demo caregiver is intentionally seeded WITHOUT profile.caregiver so that the caregiver-complete-profile card shows on their home — if a test persists profile.caregiver on this account, clean it with mongosh 'db.users.updateOne({email:"acompanante@amodo.app"},{$unset:{"profile.caregiver":""}})'. The header back arrow testID is 'header-back-button' (defined in src/ui.tsx:207). Caregiver onboarding steps order is welcome, relation, duties, hard, organize, at_hand, availability, wellbeing, link, done (10 total). OptionCards custom-add button is labelled 'Agregar' and renders disabled until the input is non-empty — don't rely on Enter/return. For kit-builder, kit-for-preferences only appears after tapping a kit-for-person-<id> chip (requires forUserId). All backend + frontend features verified on https://poco-a-poco--3e6fixmx.preview.emergentagent.com.
rca_of_issue: n/a — all requested features implemented correctly end-to-end. The user-reported bug (caregiver seeing patient questions in onboarding) is fully resolved: Onboarding() in /app/frontend/app/onboarding.tsx dispatches based on user.role; caregivers see CaregiverOnboarding() with its own 10-step questionnaire, and the patient-only phrase 'más allá de tu tratamiento' does not appear anywhere in the caregiver flow or caregiver Home.
